findings.claim: In admin-ui, error-invalid-multivalued-size was rewritten from i18next {{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}} placeholders to Java MessageFormat {0}..{2,choice,...} syntax. The Admin UI loads it with plain i18next and no ICU plugin, so the raw template text is shown instead of interpolated values.

In account-ui, error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed from i18next {{N}} placeholders to MessageFormat {N}/choice syntax. account-ui uses default i18next interpolation without i18next-icu, so the string renders with raw placeholders.
totpStep1 in the Simplified Chinese locale file messages_zh_CN.properties uses Traditional Chinese characters (手機, 安裝, 應用程式) instead of Simplified forms (手机, 安装, 应用程序).

In the Lithuanian bundles messages_lt.properties (account totpStep1 and login loginTotpStep1), the value was replaced with the Italian text 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:' instead of Lithuanian.
normalizeValue has special cases for specific keys (templateHelp, optimizeLookupHelp, linkExpirationFormatter, error-invalid-multivalued-size, email RTL styles) that bypass parts of sanitization.
In verifySafeHtml, failures reading the file or its derived _en counterpart are rethrown as raw RuntimeException instead of MojoExecutionException, which is inconsistent with the rest of verify().
Anchors are matched by position against the English string, so a valid translation that reorders links is flagged. In addition, ANCHOR_PATTERN </?a[^>]*> also matches <abbr>, <area> and <audio>.
The method name 'santizeAnchors' is misspelled; it should be 'sanitizeAnchors'.

The new dependencies, including owasp-java-html-sanitizer 20240325.1, have hard-coded versions in the module pom.xml. This duplicates the root pom.xml owasp.html.sanitizer.version property instead of being managed centrally, which allows version drift.

The check compares the value to the sanitizer's re-serialized output instead of checking that nothing was removed. As a result, equivalent markup such as
, or < p> fails the build.
POLICY_SOME_HTML, POLICY_NO_HTML and HTML_TAGS use constant naming but are non-static instance fields rebuilt per instance. This is inconsistent with the private static final ANCHOR_PATTERN.

In messages_ka.properties, lines 172, 174, 451 and 452 use '
{0}' without a space, while other locales use '
{0}'.

The common prefix/suffix trimming that builds the 'Illegal HTML' message does not cap start+end at the shorter string length. Overlapping indices make substring throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException and abort the Mojo.
Anchor sanitization consumes English matcher groups without validating counts, so a translation with more anchor tags than the English text can produce incorrect validation results.
The 'Didn't find anchor tag … in original string' error message omits the message key and file, unlike the 'Illegal HTML' message.
The commons-text dependency version 1.13.0 is outdated compared with 1.15.0.
All tests are positive detections, and no test asserts that a valid bundle yields zero messages. The duplicate-keys assertion was loosened from contains to hasItem.
The theme verifier anchor check does not fail when a translation drops an anchor present in the source, so translations can lose links and still pass.
For allowlisted keys, the whole {N,choice,...} block is replaced with '...' before sanitizing, so HTML inside a translator-supplied choice branch passes the check.
The owasp-java-html-sanitizer dependency version 20240325.1 is outdated compared with 20260313.1.

Email bundle detection uses file.getAbsolutePath().contains('email'), and English path derivation uses replaceAll over the absolute path. A checkout directory containing 'email' or 'resources-community' therefore changes behaviour for every file.
The sanitize/unescape/strip-comment/trim-diff pipeline and the commons-text dependency duplicate functionality available through OWASP's HtmlChangeListener.
The test fixture value 'Some <div>tag</div' has a malformed closing tag missing '>'.
getEnglishValue uses MissingResourceException for control flow instead of checking bundleEnglish.containsKey(key).
The new translator-facing HTML rules (HTML only where English has HTML; only br/p/strong/b; anchors identical to English) are not documented.
santizeAnchors modifies value via replaceFirst while iterating matches, which can misbehave with repeated identical anchors.
santizeAnchors and getEnglishValue take an unused key parameter, and 'numberic' is misspelled at L94.

coverage: pooled issues; severity and verdict are placeholders
